modifier.esotericism_tinker.stigmata.fla: Dance, for every joyous yesterday and every tomorrow that shall never come—nothing can set you and me apart.
modifier.esotericism_tinker.stigmata.des: Gain the traits of materials recorded through the stages of Manifestation, Alteration, and Sealing. Stigmata must be branded at the Transcendence Anvil.
Exaltation
It begins to lift all that it touches; none know who shall rise next.
It forgets the difference between burden and bearer; foe and wielder alike are raised.
It knows only that all things must leave the earth.
It rises from your flesh, lifting all around you.
It no longer remembers who should remain below.
In time, it shall offer even you to the sky.
Malediction
It leaves corruption behind; those who linger shall bear its price.
It refuses to let corruption fade; none who breathe are spared.
At last, the land itself becomes the curse.
It escapes through your wounds, tainting those nearby.
It no longer remembers who first bled.
Where you stand becomes pestilent ground.
Judgement
Lightning begins to answer your strikes, though never where it was expected.
Lightning slowly forgets its first target; bystanders and even you may bear its verdict.
The Stigmata no longer needs your will to summon lightning. Whoever stands beneath it may receive judgement.
Lightning gathers around you, waiting to descend.
Lightning forgets why it was called, remembering only that you once beckoned it.
You no longer call the lightning; you have become the place where it chooses to fall.
Obsession
It calls wandering spirits; their obsession still knows its quarry.
The spirits slowly forget their master.
In the end, obsession alone continues the hunt.
Your wounds beckon restless spirits.
They no longer know friend from foe.
Their hatred answers only itself.
Incubation
It nurtures frail life, awaiting its harvest.
It begins to favor prey that has yet to mature.
It no longer cares who the true prey is.
Your wounds give birth to new life.
They are born wherever blood is spilled.
Soon they seek fresh nourishment of their own.
Defilement
The earth begins to remember your passing.
Those who follow no longer tread upon the same ground.
Those who come after have forgotten what the earth once was.
The earth begins to answer your footsteps.
Where you stand slowly ceases to resemble what it once was.
Those who come after will believe the earth was always this way.
Devouring
It begins to demand your hunger.
It gradually forgets what satisfaction means.
At last, it begins to consume its bearer.
Every wound sharpens its hunger.
It gradually learns to measure pain in hunger.
In time, it shall devour every blow you suffer.
Sacrament
It accepts your knowledge as a temporary sacrament.
It gradually comes to prefer knowledge over sustenance.
At last, it regards all experience as an offering.
Every wound offers up a measure of knowledge.
It begins to await the next offering.
At last, it learns to feed upon suffering.
Offering
It will drink a drop of blood rather than suffer wear.
It gradually forgets the difference between iron and blood.
It no longer knows iron, only blood.
It will repay every fracture with blood.
It begins to prefer bleeding over breaking.
In time, it shall demand blood for every scar.
Immolation
Flame begins to linger in your wake.
Flame gradually forgets the bounds of its altar.
At last, flame offers all that can burn unto itself.
Flame begins to answer your wounds.
Flame gradually forgets whom it was meant to burn.
In the end, flame leaves no mere witness untouched.
Penance
It grants burden, and with burden, strength.
Its weight gradually reshapes your body.
At last, penance becomes your nature.
Every wound makes the burden more real.
Your steps begin to learn endurance.
In the end, even standing becomes an ordeal.
Dominion
It acknowledges the rider.
It gradually forgets those who walk.
In the end, it serves only those who remain mounted.
It extends its shelter to the rider.
It begins to scorn those who travel on foot.
Those who dismount shall find no shelter left.
Nocturne
The full moon begins to answer your Stigmata.
Moonlight gradually forgets the day.
Beyond the appointed moon, there is no grace.
Moonlight begins to linger at your side.
Daylight gradually loses its shelter.
Only moonlight remains willing to acknowledge you.
Zenith
The high heavens begin to look down upon you.
The firmament gradually forgets the lowlands.
Only the high heavens still acknowledge your existence.
The firmament grants you a moment of shelter.
The lowlands gradually fall beyond grace.
Those who leave the heavens shall find no shelter below.
Abyss
The abyss begins to answer your footsteps.
The abyss gradually forgets the surface.
Only the abyss still remembers your name.
The depths begin to accept your presence.
The surface gradually abandons you.
In time, you shall belong to the abyss.
Beatitude
Blessing begins to acknowledge your name.
Blessing gradually forgets the common multitude.
Only the chosen remain beneath its favor.
Grace begins to linger at your side.
Grace gradually withdraws from the many.
Lose the name of the chosen, and all shelter is lost.
Anathema
The curse begins to acknowledge your name.
The curse gradually forgets purity.
Only the forsaken remain beneath its favor.
Calamity begins to walk beside you.
Purity gradually withdraws from your shadow.
When the curse departs, its shelter departs with it.
